text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: elevated 5xx + response timeouts on streaming gateway path detected (prod). 5xx rate 14.8% over last 10m, errors concentrated on /v1/stream endpoints. Auto-pager triggered.

sam: seeing it on dashboards too — streaming gateway error spike at 11:02 UTC. Gateway 95th latency jumped to 4.2s. Root cause unclear yet, could be upstream or ingress.

anita: @sam paging in. I'm taking first pass. Can someone confirm if this is present in Dedicated/private customers or just hosted?

sam: quick check: top errors are 502/504 from ingress -> backend timeouts; small subset are chunked encoding partial closes. No obvious spike in model servers CPU.

carla: adding logs from ingress for a sample trace id: 7f3a2c. snippet: ```
[ingress] 2024-09-12T11:03:02Z TRACE id=7f3a2c upstream_conn_reset: true write_error: broken_pipe
[ingress] 2024-09-12T11:03:02Z CHUNKED_CLIENT_CLOSE seq=42
```

leo: looks like client cancels mid-stream and ingress isn't cleaning up fast, leaving connections in CLOSE_WAIT and causing resource pressure. I see socket backlog at 85% on gateway-0.

ops-engineer: I'm seeing the same pattern — Envoy upstream HEALTHY but backend chunks are returning 200 then connection reset. Possible interactions with proxy_buffering / chunked_transfer settings.

sam: initial mitigation ideas: 1) increase gateway replicas 2) tighten connection timeout/idle settings 3) fallback non-streaming for high-error customers 4) add short-term per-org rate limit to new streaming sessions. Thoughts?

anita: I'll try scale first and toggle buffering flags. Scaling cheap and quick. Doing: ```kubectl scale deploy/gateway -n prod --replicas=12```

deploy-bot: rollout started: deployment/gateway scaled from 6 -> 12 (by anita)

carla: while that's happening, we should reduce upstream idle timeout to force faster failovers. Proposed patch (nginx/Envoy): set proxy_read_timeout=15 and disable proxy_buffering for streaming routes.

leo: applying envoy patch now to edge filter: ```PATCH /configs/edge-http
- upstream_idle_timeout: 60s
+ upstream_idle_timeout: 15s
+ chunked_response_buffering: false
```

ops-engineer: quick note — disabling buffering may increase RPS on model servers but should reduce chunked encoding wait. Keep an eye on model server CPU.

sam: also enabling temporary 429 gating for new streaming sessions to throttle ingress while we stabilize. Applying a short-lived rate-limit policy for orgs > 100k tokens/day.

carla: added policy: ```
rate-limit: streaming_new_sessions: 20/min per-org (temp)
```

incident-bot: Customer impact: A subset of streaming requests are failing with 5xx; non-streaming APIs unaffected. Estimated affected requests: ~18% of streaming traffic, ~3% of total API calls. Top customers: org-42, org-77 showing higher error rates.

anita: scale completed. Gateway pods now 12. Memory/cpu utilization per pod dropped ~40%. Watching error rate.

sam: metrics update (2m later): 5xx down from 14.8% -> 6.3%, timeouts reduced. Still seeing intermittent chunked disconnects.

leo: I pushed a small nginx snippet to disable chunked responses for problematic route as temporary fallback: ```
location /v1/stream {
  proxy_buffering off;
  proxy_http_version 1.1;
  chunked_transfer_encoding off;
}
```

carla: rolled back some recent ingress config that touched keepalive behaviour (last deploy at 10:45), rolling restart of those proxies in flight. Command used: ```kubectl rollout restart daemonset/ingress -n prod```

ops-engineer: after restart + scale + rate-limits, the 5xx rate is now 1.9% over last 5m and streaming latency 95th back to ~700ms. Client cancellations still visible but not causing gateway-wide saturation.

sam: great. we should still do a postmortem root cause so this doesn't recur. Initial hypothesis: a combination of a recent keepalive/keepalive pool change + chunked response buffering behavior allowed stale connections and partial closes to exhaust file descriptors leading to proxy write errors.

carla: agreed. next steps: - keep temporary rate-limits in place for 6h - keep scaled replicas until tomorrow morning - deploy a fix that adjusts keepalive pool config + explicit connection close on chunk termination - add alerting on CLOSE_WAIT/socket backlog threshold

anita: I'll draft the post-incident notes. Also handing off to @kevin for overnight watch. Kevin — I'll summarize actions and what to watch.

kevin: taking handoff. Thanks @anita. What's the checklist?

anita: checklist for overnight: 1) monitor streaming 5xx % (alert if >3% for 15m) 2) watch gateway socket backlog (alert if >70%) 3) verify rate-limit logs to make sure legitimate customers not throttled excessively 4) if 5xx climbs again, revert chunked_transfer_encoding -> stay disabled and route org-42 to non-streaming fallback.

kevin: got it. I'll keep an eye on it. Ping me on pager if it climbs.

sam: small follow-up: open a deploy ticket to revert the temporary nginx chunked change once fix is in. Assign to eng-runtime for the fix.

incident-bot: Incident severity: SEV-2 -> lowered to SEV-3 (limited customer impact, mitigation in place).

ops-engineer: quick note — recorded a heap of traces and uploaded to s3://redwood-incident-archives/1982102468/ for postmortem. Trace ids: 7f3a2c, 7f3a9d, 7f3b0f.

carla: thanks team. Monitoring stable for 20m. I'm going to remove temporary 429 policy in 3h if no regressions.

kevin: handoff accepted. I'll update channel if anything flares. night. :moon:
